adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the test `it "raises an error with a missing host"` no longer clears any embedding-allowlist state (it removed `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = nil`) and it also does not stub `request.referer`. With the new controller logic (`EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` now only checks `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)`), a nil/missing referer will cause `host_allowed?` to return false and raise `invalid referer host`, so the spec can pass without asserting the behavior when *no EmbeddableHost exists but a referer is present*. This is a test coverage/clarity issue rather than a production defect.
